properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Storage Account: TLS 1.2 Minimum Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Storage Accounts with a minimum TLS version below 1.2. FedRAMP High requires transmission confidentiality (SC-8). TLS 1.0 and 1.1 have known vulnerabilities and are prohibited per NIST SP 800-52 Rev 2. Azure Storage uses FIPS 140-2 validated TLS implementation.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Storage Accounts with TLS < 1.2. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
